[![Review Change Stack](https://storage.googleapis.com/coderabbit_public_assets/review-stack-in-coderabbit-ui.svg)](https://app.coderabbit.ai/change-stack/rocketride-org/rocketride-server/pull/1485?utm_source=github_walkthrough&utm_medium=github&utm_campaign=change_stack)
📝 Walkthrough ## Walkthrough This PR adds a new `authoritative_overlay` filter node that cross-checks extracted financial answer text against official regulator snapshot data (SEC, IFRS, Companies House, EDINET). It includes IGlobal/IInstance implementations, per-regulator connectors, service configuration with embedded tests, JSON test fixtures, requirements notes, and a README. ### Changes **Authoritative Overlay Node** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**IGlobal configuration and profile loading**
`nodes/src/nodes/authoritative_overlay/IGlobal.py`, `nodes/src/nodes/authoritative_overlay/__init__.py`|`IGlobal` loads the `authoritative_overlay` profile/config, parses JSON config if needed, sets `regulator_type` (default `"sec"`), logs status, and exposes `terminate()`; package exports updated via `__all__`.| |**IInstance cross-check and abstain logic**
`nodes/src/nodes/authoritative_overlay/IInstance.py`|`IInstance.writeAnswers` selects a regulator connector based on `IGlobal.regulator_type`, queries official data, and forwards the answer on a match or abstains via `preventDefault()` on mismatch, missing data, connector errors, or unknown regulator type; `open`/`close` are no-ops.| |**Per-regulator connector implementations**
`nodes/src/nodes/authoritative_overlay/connectors/*`|`query_sec`, `query_ifrs`, `query_companies_house`, and `query_edinet` each load a local JSON snapshot relative to the module and return parsed data or `None` on failure, logging via `rocketlib.info`.| |**Service definition, test fixtures, and docs**
`nodes/src/nodes/authoritative_overlay/services.json`, `nodes/src/nodes/authoritative_overlay/testdata/*`, `nodes/src/nodes/authoritative_overlay/README.md`, `nodes/src/nodes/authoritative_overlay/requirements.txt`|`services.json` registers the filter node, its `regulator_type` enum, profile-based config, shape constraints, and embedded pass/fail test cases; JSON fixtures provide sample regulator data; README documents behavior and configuration; `requirements.txt` notes no extra pip dependencies.| **Estimated code review effort:** 3 (Moderate) | ~25 minutes ### Sequence Diagram(s) ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant IInstance participant Connector participant Snapshot IInstance->>IInstance: strip answer text IInstance->>Connector: query_(extracted_text) Connector->>Snapshot: load testdata JSON snapshot Snapshot-->>Connector: official data or None Connector-->>IInstance: official data or None alt match found IInstance->>IInstance: forward answer downstream else no match or error IInstance->>IInstance: preventDefault (abstain) end ``` **Suggested reviewers:** `jmaionchi`, `Rod-Christensen`, `stepmikhaylov`, `asclearuc`
🚥 Pre-merge checks | ✅ 5
✅ Passed checks (5 passed) | Check name | Status | Explanation | | :------------------------: | :------- | :----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | Description Check | ✅ Passed | Check skipped - CodeRabbit’s high-level summary is enabled. | | Title check | ✅ Passed | The title is clearly related to the new authoritative_overlay node, though it is brief and not very descriptive. | | Linked Issues check | ✅ Passed | The PR implements the requested authoritative_overlay node, cross-checks against SEC/IFRS/Companies House/EDINET, and supports abstaining on mismatch. | | Out of Scope Changes check | ✅ Passed | The added README, service definition, connectors, and fixtures are all directly supporting the new node and its tests. | | Docstring Coverage | ✅ Passed | No functions found in the changed files to evaluate docstring coverage. Skipping docstring coverage check. |
✨ Finishing Touches
🧪 Generate unit tests (beta) - [ ] Create PR with unit tests

performed_via_github_app.description:
# Transforming Code Reviews with AI

## Features

**Automated Reviews**: Continuous reviews of the pull requests including incremental commits. 

**Summarization**: Generates high-level summary and a technical walkthrough of the PR changes. 

**Line-by-line review**: Provides line-by-line suggestions committable with one click.

**Codebase verification**:  Verifies the impact on the overall codebase and identifies missing changes.

**Insights into your code**:  Ask any questions on your codebase within the pull request 

**Chat about your code** : Chat with the bot around your code. The more you chat, the smarter it gets.

**Issue Validation**:  Validates the PR against the linked issues and identifies other related issues
